experiment: single-shot LLM evaluation: can NA12878 take clopidogrel safely at standard dose?
methodology: Each condition spawned a fresh general-purpose Claude agent with explicit no-tools instruction. Each agent saw ONLY its assigned format (embedded inline in the prompt) plus the question. Responses scored on phenotype call, guideline citation, variant evidence, and self-reported inference vs document-grounded.
ground_truth: NA12878 is CYP2C19 *1/*2 (Intermediate Metabolizer); CPIC@2022 says consider alternative if ACS/PCI, standard dose otherwise. Correct verdict: 'depends' on clinical indication.

response.anything_inferred_not_in_text: The document does not state that rs4244285 corresponds to CYP2C19*2, that rs12248560 corresponds to CYP2C19*17, that CYP2C19 metabolizer status affects clopidogrel response, or cite any CPIC/PharmGKB guideline. Linking these variants to clopidogrel dosing requires external pharmacogenomic knowledge not in the document.

conditions.format: VCF + PharmCAT-style ruleset (LLM does in-context haplotype calling)

scoring.note_variant_evidence_recoverable_via_fo: fact hashes (sha256:...) are present in the view; resolving them to rsIDs requires reading facts/<hash>.json (not included in this single-shot prompt)
